newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Spring/White Wheat - Bids rise further.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Spring/White Wheat - Bids rise further.

text.p: Spring wheat bids were sharply higher in many country locations on Tuesday as elevators hiked basis values to encourage farmer selling, cash merchants said.

"We only had 15 (rail) cars for receipts today," a Minneapolis-based merchant said. "Farmer interest is showing up as the board goes up but they're not doing much selling. It's mostly inquiries right now."
MGE spring wheat futures were also higher, which added to gains in flat prices. The December contract closed up six cents per bushel at $4.07-1/2 on Tuesday, the highest close since October 23.
The higher values did attract some selling interest among farmers in North Dakota, a merchant there said.
"There was a little bit of wheat trading, finally," the merchant said. "We're getting up into some numbers where we're finding a bit of interest."
